acquisition.method: GET FITS through official CDS hips2fits
acquisition.ordering: Frozen manifest order then blue, red, NIR. At most three in flight; global one-second start spacing. Cached completed request slots never queried again. Failures retained without substitution; no automatic retries; report incompleteness if any.

footprint_graph.future_constraint: Every connected component of overlapping fields must stay in one future split, or observations must be prospectively excluded. No split is constructed here.
footprint_graph.geometry: Closed convex spherical TAN footprint at pixel outer edges 0.5 and 512.5; union across all three band footprints. Failed or unavailable WCS additionally uses conservative planned TAN footprint; status explicit. All 473 choose 2 pairs tested with spherical cap rejection then vertex containment and great-circle edge intersections. Boundary touching counts as overlap. No centre-only approximation.
footprint_graph.interpretation: Field overlap is a dependence constraint, not evidence of identical physical targets.
footprint_graph.unit: Every frozen physical-object candidate, including reserves; physical identities remain from catalogue

fov_rule.extent: max of positive frozen major/minor axes in arcmin. If absent, twice frozen Harris half_light_radius_arcmin as half-light-diameter proxy. If neither available, extent unknown.
fov_rule.fov_arcmin: clip(2*extent,5,120), or15 for missing extent. Identical recipe across objects, never based on pixel/model outcome.
fov_rule.limitations: Harris radius is not full outer extent. Catalogue axis reversals and implausibly large extents are flagged, not repaired. Capped or unknown sizes require review; no post-image FOV adaptation.

image_geometry.coordinate_source: Frozen numeric RA/Dec only; no online name resolver

isolation: Writes only under dataset_v2c_acquisition_qc; preserve v2A/v2B bytes; no v1 science records, predictions, checkpoints, training, inference, benchmark admission, labels, splits, manuscript or Git mutations. No packages or extra bands or image services.

prospective_qc_labels.review_needed: Any fixed screening/scale/prior visual/overlap flag, or visual inspection pending; technical products preserved.
prospective_qc_labels.technical_pass: All three required products pass integrity/WCS and fixed screens, scale checks, and documented visual review finds no issue. This does not admit the object or certify identity.
prospective_qc_labels.unusable_technical_failure: Missing required product, HTTP/FITS/WCS/provenance failure, all pixels missing or inconsistent three-band grids. No repair/replacement.

rendering.orientation: Flip FITS row direction for north-up if unrotated east-left TAN matrix verifies. Do not rewrite FITS.
rendering.per_band: Finite pixels;1st/99th percentiles, clip0..1 then asinh(10*x)/asinh(10), invalid black, round8-bit; no local adaptive/tuned scaling.
rendering.pseudo_colour: R=DSS2 NIR,G=DSS2 red,B=DSS2 blue, same per-band stretch; explicitly not calibrated true colour.
rendering.purpose: Deterministic local inspection only; no fixed final training RGB is certified by this pilot.
rendering.visual_review: Preserve completed v2B visual findings. All remaining products receive fixed automated artifact/coverage/centering screens and deterministic three-band/composite contact sheets. Record any actual human/assistant inspection separately; no unperformed manual inspection is claimed. Pending full visual inspection is review_needed, never benchmark admission.

reuse: The sixty originals remain at their immutable v2B repository paths; no copying needed, no downloads. Full provenance, hashes and request identities referenced in C.
rights: Reuse immutable v2B survey_reuse_policy.json and retained official metadata. Local research products, retain DSS/CDS/STScI attribution and underlying policy limitations.

technical_qc.FITS: HTTP200; SIMPLE primary image, exactly512x512; supported BITPIX; complete2880-byte blocks and complete data payload; preserve all header cards.
technical_qc.WCS: RA---TAN,DEC--TAN; invertible CD or PC/CDELT matrix; finite CRVAL/CRPIX; requested centre at reference point within1arcsec and within1output pixel of geometrical centre. Analytic TAN inverse check, no astropy installation.
technical_qc.artifact_caveat: Screening proxies plus visual review, not a guarantee of artifact-free plates.
technical_qc.band_provenance: Exact frozen query survey_id plus retained properties and returned FITS history/origin; explicitly note if original plate/exposure IDs or copyright are absent from resampled products.
technical_qc.centering_caveat: WCS/catalogue centering is geometric, not independent visual identification or proof that a diffuse object is detectable.
technical_qc.invalid_definition: Nonfinite or integer BLANK keyword; zeros recorded separately, not presumed missing without BLANK evidence.
technical_qc.saturation_caveat: Repeated maxima are a clipping/saturation proxy, not calibrated photographic saturation proof.
